learnings: `while` fits loops whose iteration count is unknown in advance (Collatz, retries, games).
`continue` skips the rest of one iteration; `break` leaves the loop; `while ... else` detects 'no break'.
An AST walker with an operator whitelist is a safe calculator; `eval` with empty builtins is not.
pitfalls: The original calculator could be escaped with `().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__()` – it was replaced.
